proof.text: Use the covering of the underlying set sheaf of F to choose a trivializing member V containing the image of the marked point. The point lifts to V by Mathlib Scheme.pointSmallEtaleFiberObjToPreimage_surjective. Refine by the fibre product with V. Pointed neighbourhoods lying over V are cofinal (each neighbourhood is refined by its fibre product with V), so the stalk and its nonzero germ of a are unchanged.

Identify the restriction of the underlying set sheaf with the constant set sheaf M. Its stalk is M: sheafification preserves geometric stalks of sets, and the constant presheaf has stalk M because the opposite category of pointed neighbourhoods is nonempty and connected. The germ of a and the zero germ correspond to distinct m,z∈M. Equality of elements in a filtered colimit holds after a common refinement. Refine the section so that its image is the constant section m and the zero section is the constant section z.

Call the refined neighbourhood U. It is nonempty because it carries the retained marked point. At any geometric point t of X and lift v to U, cofinality identifies the germ with that on the trivializing member. The constant-sheaf stalk computation identifies a and zero with m and z, still distinct. Thus the germ of a is nonzero for every Ω,t,v as asserted. No compatibility with group addition of the set-sheaf trivialization is needed.

title: Refinement to everywhere nonzero germs
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and F an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with locally constant underlying set sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let U be an etale X-scheme, a a section of F on U, and v a lift to U of a geometric point t:Spec Ω→X with Ω algebraically closed. Assume the geometric germ of a at v [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is nonzero. There is a morphism r:V→U of etale X-schemes with V nonempty such that the germ of the restriction F(r)(a) is nonzero at every geometric lift to V.

lean.statement:
theorem refine_section_nonzero_germs (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hF : IsLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F))
    (U : X.Etale) (a : F.obj.obj (op U))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (v : (pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj U)
    (ha : (pointSmallEtale t).toPresheafFiber U v F.obj a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (V : X.Etale) (r : V ⟶ U), Nonempty V.left ∧
      ∀ (Ω' : Type u) [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω']
        (t' : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ X) (v' : (pointSmallEtale t').fiber.obj V),
        (pointSmallEtale t').toPresheafFiber V v' F.obj
          (F.obj.map r.op a) ≠ 0
